quote: I really enjoyed this training and it taught me a lot about myself, my work relationships and how I can improve my communication best to suit my role. Martin made us feel really as ease so I was more than happy to speak during the session and he would tailor questions/ideas to us if we felt the first time it didn't really suit our situation. I learnt a lot and would be more than happy to attend another training of yours. Thank you for coming to see us.
author: Francesca Stevens
subject: Communication Skills
